items.html: And the first four of Assiya rose, for such is the measure of the Nukva of ZA — four Sefirot only — and the remaining six other Sefirot of Assiya [rose] to the place of the six first [Sefirot] of the present Beria. Indeed, also Aba and Ima of Atzilut, and all that is above them, likewise rose above their degree according to this order, and there is no need to elaborate on them.
